_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Klondike Solitariuta pukllanki. Q'umir q'illaykunata t'ikrana q'umir wasikunaman apayta q'umir q'illay. 

Pukllay q'anq'ay:
- Q'umir wasikuna (F1-F4): Ace-manta Rey-kama q'umir q'illayta q'umir 
- T'ikrana wasikuna (T1-T7): Q'umir q'illayta ch'in q'umirpi (puka q'ara q'umirpi, q'ara q'umir puka q'umirpi) 
- Q'umir q'illay q'ipi: Q'umir q'illayta q'umir q'ipipaq 
- Q'umir q'ipipaq (W): Q'umir q'illay q'ipipaqta ñawpa q'umir q'illay 

Q'anq'aykuna:
- 'draw' - Q'umir q'illay q'ipipaqmanta q'umir q'ipipaq 
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Q'umir q'illayta q'umir wasikunapura 
  Uyarinakuna: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. count-pas 'all'-pis kanqa, tukuy ñawpa q'umir q'illaykunata apayta q'umir. 
- 'forfeit' - Pukllayta tukuyta q'umir q'ipipaqta 
- Q'umir wasikunapura: W (q'umir q'ipipaq), F1-F4 (q'umir wasikuna), T1-T7 (t'ikrana wasikuna) 

Tukuy q'anq'aykunata huk p'unchaypi q'umir q'anq'ayta, q'anq'aykunata q'umir q'ipipaqpi kanqa:
  Uyarinakuna: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1' 

Q'ara q'umir q'illaykunallamanta t'ikrana wasikunaman apayta kanqa. 
Q'anq'aykunata q'umir q'ipipaqta, huk q'anq'ayqa manch'akuptinqa, wak q'anq'aykunata q'ipipaqta kanqa. 
'forfeit'ta q'umir q'anq'ayta, pukllay imposible kanqaptinqa.

format_error.no_brackets: Mana allin ruwaykuna, mana allinta ruwasqa.
format_error.no_closing_bracket: Mana allin ruwaykuna. mana tukukuq paréntesis "]"
format_error.empty_command: Mana ima kamachiy. "draw" icha "move <source> <destination> [count]" nisqaman qillqay.
format_error.move_needs_args: Move kamachiyqa maymantachus, imawantaq ripunanta munan. Usualidad: 'move <source> <destination> [count]'
format_error.count_invalid: Mana allin willakuy. "all" nisqawan qillqay, icha huk yupayta utilizay.

move_result.cannot_draw: Mana atichwanchu, mana ima qollqe kanqachu.
move_result.invalid_pile: Mana allin sutin. W, F1-F4, T1-T7 nisqakunawan qillqay

move_result.tableau_to_foundation_bad: Manan ima cartatapis chay t'ikamanqa apachikuyta atinchu. 🔍

move_result.waste_to_tableau_ok: Cartilla de residuos nisqawan T{dst} tablapi churasqa.
move_result.waste_to_tableau_bad: Manan tarjeta q'epikunataqa chay tablero-man churayta atinchu.

move_result.tableau_to_tableau_bad: Mana {count} k'atakuna wasi T{src} wasi T{dst} tiyaykachiy atin.
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_one_card: Uchuymanta ch'ulla t'ikamanqa huk kartallata apakunman.

outcome.turn_limit: Pukllay tukuy ñiqiwan tiyaykachisqa! {max_turns} ñiqikuna tukusqa. Q'umirayki ñiqi: {score} k'atakuna tukuy wasikunapi.
